items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Joe worked with Sarah Vaughn, Billy Taylor --

ctx.x: Well, he didn't have a steady job. He was tiptoeing through the tulips, trying to get connected, you know. Until finally he got a job with Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers, and from there he went on. He was working with just about everybody, you know.
Like Joe did. Joe worked with Sarah Vaughn, Billy Taylor --
